mcqs.q: What is the derivative of a constant, like d/dx(5)?
options: The derivative of 5 is 1 because all constants differentiate to 1.
The derivative of 5 is 5 because the constant stays the same.
It means the vectors are parallel.
0 — constants do not change with x.

mcqs.q: If the dot product of two non-zero vectors is zero, what does that mean?
options: It means the vectors are parallel.
The vectors are perpendicular to each other.
It means at least one of the vectors is the zero vector.
Take the average of the probabilities on the branches.
